text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
And now, the Tenno Sho (Autumn) is finally 
upon us!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Before the race, could you please give us 
a word on your enthusiasm?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Before sharing my enthusiasm for the 
race... would it be alright if I put on a 
little show?

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Of course!

Fuji Kiseki calmly produced a single rose 
and draped a handkerchief over it—
(Rustle)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now then, wherever could the vanished rose 
have gone?

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? It really disappeared! There's 
nothing in either hand! Wait—

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Huh!? When did this get into my pocket!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I heard today is your birthday. 
Here's a little present.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you! Wait, you look completely 
relaxed, Fuji Kiseki-san!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. All I have to do is what I need to 
do.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"The absolute best entertainment, 
something that will stay in all your 
hearts."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Lady Fuji's expression seems different 
from usual...! I feel like we're going to 
see something amazing today!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
You over there! It's time to get out your 
Fuji-sama colored handkerchief~!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Good manners mean waving at chest level! 
Let's cheer properly and purely today too!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Fan A
text_block_list.text: Okaaay! Eek, my heart is pounding!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —There we go. The seeds have been sown.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer-san. Please make sure to 
relax and take it easy today.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I will bring you victory without fail.

With those words... Fuji Kiseki's composed 
expression cracked just a little.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, glad to hear that.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you and Mother, I can finally 
see what I need to do.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer-san. I'm all right now. 
I promise I'll make sure everyone has a 
wonderful time.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Because it's the brightest star in the 
night sky—the one that you recognized.
